name: io.github.drscrewdriver/dsh-windows-parallel-mcp
title: Windows Parallel
description: Drive a Windows window over MCP stdio: quiet by default, one policy ceiling, coded refusals.

environmentVariables.name: WPM_POLICY
environmentVariables.description: Authorization ceiling over all eleven actions: readonly | quiet | balanced | full. Default balanced. A call above it is refused with policy_denied, and the next step is to raise this setting, not to retry.

environmentVariables.name: WPM_TAKEOVER_ALLOWED
environmentVariables.description: Capability switch for the takeover tier (the real cursor moving to the action point). Default false, and it is not implied by WPM_POLICY=full: both are needed.

environmentVariables.name: WPM_KEY_INJECT_ALLOWED
environmentVariables.description: Capability switch for keyInput:'inject' (synthetic keyboard input into the foreground target). Default false.

environmentVariables.name: WPM_APP_LAUNCH_ALLOWED
environmentVariables.description: Capability switch for the launch action. Default false; nothing may start while it is off.

environmentVariables.name: WPM_APP_LAUNCH_ALLOW
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated exact-name whitelist for launch (case-folded, no wildcard, no prefix match). Empty by default. A whitelist vouches for a program, not for the arguments it is given; both the target and the arguments are written to the audit log.

environmentVariables.name: WPM_POLICY_IDLE_MS
environmentVariables.description: How long the owner must have been away from the keyboard before a takeover-grade action is allowed. Default 3000. While they are active the call is refused with user_active rather than interrupting them; no dialog is offered instead.

environmentVariables.name: WPM_OVERLAY
environmentVariables.description: The click-through overlay and the global pause chord (Ctrl+Alt+Q). Default true -- a visible aid that tells the human something is being driven. Set false only if the hotkey cannot be registered on this machine.

environmentVariables.name: WPM_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: Master switch. Default true. False refuses every action with paused before anything is touched -- a switched-off plugin does not so much as start its sidecar.

environmentVariables.name: WPM_SETTLE_MS
environmentVariables.description: How long the engine waits after a write before it reads the control back. Default 350. The read-back prediction is built after this window, so a value that is too small reports readbackMismatch rather than lying about success.

environmentVariables.name: WPM_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Budget for one sidecar round trip. Default 20000.

environmentVariables.name: WPM_POWERSHELL_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to the PowerShell executable, for a machine where powershell.exe is not on PATH. Default empty (find it the usual way).

environmentVariables.name: WPM_LOG_WORKER_STDERR
environmentVariables.description: Forward the sidecar's stderr to this server's stderr. Default false; switch it on when a worker dies before answering.

environmentVariables.name: WPM_TAKEOVER_MAX_MS
environmentVariables.description: Longest a single takeover may hold the cursor. Default 10000, clamped 500-60000; it is a ceiling on the tier, not a way to opt in.

environmentVariables.name: WPM_TAKEOVER_ARM_MS
environmentVariables.description: The HUD's arm phase before the cursor moves. Default 800, so a human sees it coming and can use the stop button or the pause chord.

environmentVariables.name: WPM_SNAPSHOT_MAX_ELEMENTS
environmentVariables.description: Element cap for one snapshot. Default 300, clamped 1-5000, and the number actually used is reported back on the result rather than assumed.

environmentVariables.name: WPM_SCREENSHOT_MAX_WIDTH
environmentVariables.description: Resize width for screenshots. Default 0 = no scaling, because a silently rescaled picture makes every coordinate the model reads wrong. Any scaling is stated on the result as scale/identity.

environmentVariables.name: WPM_SHOTS_KEEP
environmentVariables.description: How many recent screenshots to retain. Default 10, clamped 1-200.

environmentVariables.name: WPM_AUDIT_KEEP
environmentVariables.description: How many newest rows of %LOCALAPPDATA%\wpm\audit.log to retain. Default 2000.

environmentVariables.name: WPM_MCP_NO_IMAGE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to stop attaching screenshot pixels as base64 image content; the text result still names the file, the rect, the scale and the capture backend.

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.requires: Windows PowerShell 5.1 (ships with Windows) and Node >= 20. No install dependencies; no build step.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.sameEngineTwoForms: lib/index.js is the DSH plugin half and lib/mcp-server.mjs is this stdio half; both drive one PowerShell engine, so the actions, the refusal vocabulary, the gates and the audit log are identical in either form.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.schemaSource: tools/list is generated from src/schema/tools.json at start-up -- the action surface is declared once.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.capabilitySummary: Eleven declared actions over one engine: window messages for a classic control (zero foreground changes), one bounded self-reversing UI Automation flash when only a pattern can reach it, and an opt-in takeover tier where the real cursor moves and is always restored. Writes are read back and the effect value names who reported success; screenshots name the capture path that painted them. Every refusal names the switch or the missing fact, and every action appends one audit row recording decisions and lengths but never the content typed or copied. Windows only, PowerShell 5.1 sidecar, zero install dependencies, no mouse-event injection.
